chunks.text: Read-only PowerShell tooling for Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) environments on Azure Commercial. The collector and validator read through Azure Resource Manager and write nothing. Their evidence packages feed avd-second-brain, which turns them into a living knowledge base of the estate.

chunks.title: 0001. Entra ID-only, greenfield, private by default
Consequences
chunks.text: A smaller surface that can be hardened and tested end to end. Organizations that need AD DS use the accelerator. Details: design-decisions.md, out-of-scope.md.

chunks.title: Context
chunks.text: Microsoft's AVD Landing Zone Accelerator covers every identity model and brownfield case through a large option surface.

chunks.title: Decision
chunks.text: This repo takes one path: Entra ID-joined, Intune-managed session hosts, Azure Files with Entra Kerberos, Private Link, no domain controllers and no line of sight to on-premises. Options that would reintroduce AD DS or hybrid networking are out of scope.

Consequences

chunks.title: Context
chunks.text: Several Az cmdlets behaved differently from their REST APIs in real runs: one object per region (lesson 0005), blocking registration (0006), invalid parameter combinations (0014).

chunks.title: Decision
chunks.text: Ops scripts go through Invoke-AvdArm (Invoke-AzRestMethod) and Invoke-AvdGraph (Invoke-MgGraphRequest, the only Graph module needed) wherever the cmdlet's shape or behavior matters. Cmdlets stay where they are simple and verified.

chunks.title: Budget start date
chunks.text: A budget's start date must be the first of a month and can't be changed once the budget is active. Set budgetStartDate to the first day of the month of your first deployment and leave it there.

chunks.title: Default outbound access can't be changed later
chunks.text: defaultOutboundAccess: false is set at subnet creation. It's immutable, so if you import an existing subnet, it keeps whatever it had.

chunks.title: Encryption at host is a subscription feature
chunks.text: deploy.sh registers Microsoft.Compute/EncryptionAtHost and waits for it. If you deploy another way, register it first or set encryptionAtHost = false.

chunks.title: The storage account won't delete
chunks.text: Azure Backup puts a delete lock on protected storage accounts. Stop protection and delete the backup data first.

chunks.title: vCPU quota and zonal capacity
chunks.text: New subscriptions often have low quota. Check it with az vm list-usage -l <region> -o table. Quota is not capacity either: a size can be unavailable in a given zone. If allocation fails, try a sibling size (for example Standard_D4s_v5) or narrow availabilityZones.
